messages:
samira_csm: Heads up 11 NimbusEdge wants to onboard a 1.2B reranker for click deduping into Redwood Private (EU-only). They need a security one-pager, PHI/PII checks, and a pilot in 5 weeks.

samira_csm: They say model is a merged PyTorch checkpoint and they1ve got offline lift numbers. Pilot target 30k q/day, canary + fallback to hosted required.

kai_eng: OK. Request: upload checkpoint to secure intake + sha256. We'll run a quantize compatibility test (4-bit) and return perf numbers. ETA 3 business days after upload.

omar_ml: For safety evals I1ll need 300 in-domain pairs + 100 adversarial probes. Plan: membership inference + PII extraction probe + basic regression tests. Deliverable: short risk summary + remediation.

ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-5010 D NimbusEdge reranker onboarding. Assignees: kai_eng, omar_ml. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/CS-5010

samira_csm: I'll ask NimbusEdge for intake files and their acceptance thresholds (they asked for "no sensitive token leak in probes"). Will confirm exact SLO.

kai_eng: Noted. If they want customer KMS for backups, ops will need endpoint + certs. Canary routing setup is straightforward.

samira_csm: Thanks all D I'll update ticket when uploads are in. :thumbsup:
